meaning.en: O great god, by even a trace of your grace I have become unshaken
meaning.hi: हे महादेव, आपकी करुणा की झलक मात्र से मैं अडिग हूँ

meaning.en: I am nothing but a solid mass of awareness
meaning.hi: मैं चेतना का ठोस पिंड ही हूँ

meaning.en: I am Shiva — what could lie beyond that
meaning.hi: मैं शिव हूँ, इससे परे क्या है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: what is truly one's own does not appear so while the inner faculty stretches outward
meaning.hi: अंतःकरण के फैलने से अपना सच्चा स्वरूप अपना नहीं दिखता

meaning.en: only once the inner faculty dissolves does pure consciousness, Hari, stand revealed
meaning.hi: अंतःकरण के नाश से ही शुद्ध चेतना हरि प्रकट होते हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: samvinmatra-sthitah cha aham ajah asmi kim atah param

meaning.en: resting in pure consciousness alone, I am unborn, what lies beyond that
meaning.hi: शुद्ध चेतना में स्थित, मैं अजन्मा हूँ, इससे परे क्या है

words.sanskrit: vyatiriktam jadam sarvam svapnavat cha vinashyati

meaning.en: everything set apart, everything inert, dissolves like a dream
meaning.hi: इससे अलग जो जड़ है वह स्वप्न की तरह मिट जाता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: whoever stands as witness of both consciousness and the inert
meaning.hi: जो चेतन-जड़ दोनों का साक्षी है

meaning.en: that witness is the unshaken one, understanding given form
meaning.hi: वही अडिग, ज्ञान का साकार रूप है

words.sanskrit: sa eva hi mahadevah sa eva hi mahaharih

meaning.en: that witness alone is the great god, that witness alone is the great Hari
meaning.hi: वही महादेव है, वही महाहरि है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: that witness is the light within every light
meaning.hi: वही हर ज्योति की ज्योति है

meaning.en: that witness is the highest lord of all
meaning.hi: वही परमेश्वर है

meaning.en: that witness is the ultimate reality itself
meaning.hi: वही परम ब्रह्म है

meaning.en: and that Brahman, I am, of this there is no doubt
meaning.hi: वही ब्रह्म मैं हूँ, इसमें संदेह नहीं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: jivah shivah shivah jivah sa jivah kevalah shivah

meaning.en: the soul is Shiva, Shiva is the soul; the soul is nothing but Shiva
meaning.hi: जीव शिव है, शिव जीव है; जीव केवल शिव है

words.sanskrit: tushena baddhah vrihih syat tusha-abhavena tandulah

meaning.en: grain stays bound within its husk; once the husk is gone, only bare rice remains
meaning.hi: छिलके में बंधा धान; छिलका हटने पर शुद्ध चावल

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: evam baddhah tatha jivah karma-nashe sadashivah

meaning.en: so the soul stays bound while karma's residue remains, and becomes ever-auspicious once it is burned away
meaning.hi: कर्म-नाश से जीव सदाशिव होता है

meaning.en: bound by its own snares it is the soul; freed of snares it stands as ever-auspicious
meaning.hi: पाशबद्ध जीव, पाशमुक्त सदाशिव

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: Shiva wearing Vishnu's form, Vishnu wearing Shiva's form
meaning.hi: शिव विष्णु-रूप, विष्णु शिव-रूप

words.sanskrit: shivasya hridayam vishnuh vishnoh cha hridayam shivah

meaning.en: Vishnu is the heart within Shiva, Shiva is the heart within Vishnu
meaning.hi: विष्णु शिव का हृदय, शिव विष्णु का हृदय

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: yatha shivamayah vishnuh evam vishnumayah shivah

meaning.en: as Vishnu is filled with Shiva, so Shiva is filled with Vishnu
meaning.hi: जैसे विष्णु शिवमय, वैसे शिव विष्णुमय

words.sanskrit: yatha antaram na pashyami tatha me svasti ayushi

meaning.en: since I see no difference, may this bring me well-being through life
meaning.hi: अंतर न देखने से मुझे आयु भर कल्याण मिले

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: yatha antaram na bhedah syuh shiva-keshavayoh tatha

meaning.en: just as there is no real difference between Shiva and Keshava
meaning.hi: जैसे शिव-केशव में भेद नहीं

meaning.en: the body is called a dwelling place for the divine
meaning.hi: देह को देवालय कहा गया

meaning.en: that very soul, nothing else, is simply Shiva
meaning.hi: वही जीव केवल शिव है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: cast off ignorance's garland, worship with the feeling 'I am That'
meaning.hi: अज्ञान की माला त्यागो, सोऽहं भाव से पूजो

meaning.en: seeing no real difference anywhere is true knowledge
meaning.hi: अभेद-दर्शन ही ज्ञान है

meaning.en: meditation is a mind settled into wanting nothing more
meaning.hi: निर्विषय मन ही ध्यान है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: drink Brahman's nectar, take simple begging to maintain the body
meaning.hi: ब्रह्म-अमृत पिएँ, देह-रक्षा हेतु भिक्षा लें

words.sanskrit: vaset ekantikah bhutva cha ekante dvaita-varjite

meaning.en: live entirely alone, settled in solitude free of duality
meaning.hi: द्वैतरहित एकांत में अकेले रहें

words.sanskrit: iti evam achared dhiman sah evam muktim apnuyat

meaning.en: whoever wise lives exactly this way attains liberation
meaning.hi: इस प्रकार जीने वाला ज्ञानी मुक्ति पाता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: peace and long life to the one dwelling in that highest abode
meaning.hi: परम धाम में बसे को शांति और दीर्घायु

meaning.en: by your grace, as Brahma, Narayana, Shankara, and the man-lion at once
meaning.hi: आपकी कृपा से ब्रह्मा-नारायण-शंकर-नृसिंह रूप में

words.sanskrit: achintyam avyaktam anantam avyayam vedatmakam brahma nijam vijanate

meaning.en: people come to know that inconceivable, unmanifest, infinite, unchanging Brahman as truly their own
meaning.hi: अचिंत्य, अव्यक्त, अनंत ब्रह्म को अपना जानते हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: tat vishnoh paramam padam sada pashyanti surayah

meaning.en: the wise, watchful ones always see that highest state of Vishnu
meaning.hi: ज्ञानी सदा विष्णु के परम पद को देखते हैं

meaning.en: the way an eye wide open sees clearly across the sky
meaning.hi: जैसे खुली आँख आकाश में देखती है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: learned ones, wide awake and radiant, kindle that highest state within themselves
meaning.hi: जागृत विद्वान उसे भीतर प्रज्वलित करते हैं

meaning.en: that highest state belonging to Vishnu
meaning.hi: विष्णु का वह परम पद

words.sanskrit: iti etat nirvana-anushasanam iti veda-anushasanam iti veda-anushasanam iti upanishat

meaning.en: this is the teaching on liberation, this is the Vedas' own teaching, so concludes this Upanishad
meaning.hi: यही मुक्ति और वेदों की शिक्षा है, यहाँ उपनिषद् समाप्त
